mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_memory_sharing_scope WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM ai_memory_sharing_scope WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND request_id=#{request} FOR UPDATE

SELECT FROM ai_memory_sharing_scope s WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND (owner_id=#{user} OR approver_id=#{user} OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_memory_sharing_member m WHERE m.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND m.scope_id=s.id AND m.user_id=#{user})) ORDER BY id LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_memory_sharing_scope SET status='ACTIVE',revision=revision+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{row.tenantId} AND id=#{row.id} AND status='PENDING' AND revision=#{row.revision}
UPDATE ai_memory_sharing_scope SET revision=revision+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{row.tenantId} AND id=#{row.id} AND revision=#{row.revision} AND status='ACTIVE'
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id,scope_id,user_id,status,revision,request_id FROM ai_memory_sharing_member WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND scope_id=#{scope} AND user_id=#{user} FOR UPDATE
SELECT tenant_id,scope_id,user_id,status,revision,request_id FROM ai_memory_sharing_member WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND scope_id=#{scope} ORDER BY user_id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_memory_sharing_member SET status=#{status},revision=revision+1,request_id=#{request} WHERE tenant_id=#{row.tenantId} AND scope_id=#{row.scopeId} AND user_id=#{row.userId} AND revision=#{row.revision} AND status=#{row.status}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_memory_sharing_grant WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM ai_memory_sharing_grant WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND request_id=#{request} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM ai_memory_sharing_grant WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND owner_id=#{owner} AND origin_agent=#{origin} AND scope_id IS NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT 100
SELECT FROM ai_memory_sharing_grant WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND scope_id=#{scope} ORDER BY id LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_memory_sharing_grant SET status=#{status},revision=revision+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{row.tenantId} AND id=#{row.id} AND revision=#{row.revision} AND status=#{row.status}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_memory_sharing_projection WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM ai_memory_sharing_projection WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND grant_id=#{grant} ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE

SELECT p.tenant_id,p.id,p.grant_id,p.user_id,p.target_agent,p.grant_revision,p.member_revision,p.state,p.expires_at,p.cleanup_deadline FROM ai_memory_sharing_projection p JOIN ai_memory_sharing_grant g ON g.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND g.id=p.grant_id WHERE p.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND g.scope_id=#{scope} AND p.user_id=#{user} ORDER BY p.id FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM ai_memory_sharing_projection WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND user_id=#{user} AND target_agent=#{agent} AND state='ACTIVE' AND expires_at>UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) ORDER BY id LIMIT 100

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_memory_sharing_projection p JOIN ai_memory_sharing_grant g ON g.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND g.id=p.grant_id JOIN ai_memory_item i ON i.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND i.id=g.item_id WHERE p.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND p.id=#{id} AND p.user_id=#{user} AND p.target_agent=#{agent} AND p.state='ACTIVE' AND p.expires_at>UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND g.status='ACTIVE' AND g.revision=p.grant_revision AND g.expires_at>UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND i.lifecycle='LIVE' AND i.current_version_id=g.version_id AND i.revision=g.item_revision AND (g.scope_id IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ai_memory_sharing_scope s JOIN ai_memory_sharing_member m ON m.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND m.scope_id=s.id WHERE s.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND s.id=g.scope_id AND s.status='ACTIVE' AND s.expires_at>UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND m.user_id=p.user_id AND m.status='ACTIVE' AND m.revision=p.member_revision))
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_memory_sharing_projection SET state='REVOKED',cleanup_deadline=DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(6),INTERVAL 24 HOUR) WHERE tenant_id=#{row.tenantId} AND id=#{row.id} AND state='ACTIVE'
UPDATE ai_memory_source SET grant_epoch=grant_epoch+1,source_epoch=source_epoch+1,deletion_epoch=deletion_epoch+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{row.tenantId} AND id=#{row.id} AND source_type='MEMORY_SHARE_GRANT'
mapper.select: SELECT o.tenant_id,o.event_id,o.aggregate_id AS projection_id,o.deletion_epoch AS epoch,o.attempts,p.cleanup_deadline FROM ai_memory_outbox o JOIN ai_memory_sharing_projection p ON p.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND p.id=o.aggregate_id WHERE o.event_type='MEMORY_SHARE_REVOKED' AND o.status IN ('QUEUED','BLOCKED','CLAIMED') AND o.attempts<8 AND (o.lease_until IS NULL OR o.lease_until<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) AND p.cleanup_deadline>UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) ORDER BY o.tenant_id,o.event_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_memory_outbox SET status='CLAIMED',revision=revision+1,attempts=attempts+1,lease_until=DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(6),INTERVAL 60 SECOND),receipt_ref=#{token} WHERE tenant_id=#{row.tenantId} AND event_id=#{row.eventId} AND attempts=#{row.attempts} AND attempts<8 AND status IN ('QUEUED','BLOCKED','CLAIMED') AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))

UPDATE ai_memory_outbox SET status='SUCCEEDED''BLOCKED',revision=revision+1,lease_until=DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(6),INTERVAL 60 SECOND) WHERE tenant_id=#{row.tenantId} AND event_id=#{row.eventId} AND status='CLAIMED' AND receipt_ref=#{token}
